text:
maria: Quick copy check — the per-route cost tooltip currently says "Estimated cost" then "$0.00 per request". QA flagged it as ambiguous: are we talking per-token or per-request?
kevin: Yep, confusion is real. Our billing is per-token but customers think in requests. We should show both with an example. :thinking_face:
sam: Proposal: header "Estimated cost" then two short lines: "~0.003 USD / 1k tokens" and "≈ 0.30 USD per response (100 tokens)". That spells out the mapping.
maria: Agree. Also — don't hardcode the $ symbol. Use currency code (USD) because some tenants will see different billing currencies.
jane: Accessibility nit — the tooltip is implemented with a title attribute only, so screen readers and keyboard users miss it. Needs role="tooltip" and aria-describedby, and must appear on focus.
ui-bot: Accessibility checklist: tooltip must be keyboard-focusable, triggerable on focus and hover, include role='tooltip', and have an explicit id referenced by aria-describedby. Keep text under 250 chars.
kevin: Tiny wording nit: prefer "per response" over "per request" since API calls can return variable-length responses; it's clearer for integrators.
sam: Draft microcopy below (for the tooltip body):
```
Estimated cost
~0.003 USD / 1k tokens
≈ 0.30 USD per response (based on 100 tokens)
How we calculate →
```
maria: That looks good. For the "How we calculate" modal, show the formula and rounding rules. E.g., cost = (tokens_used / 1000) * model_price_per_1k. Show a small example calculation.
jane: Also add a one-line caveat: "Approximate values only — actual billed amount may vary with rounding and tool outputs." Keep it short.
kevin: Important: prepend "≈" or "~" to the numbers to avoid implying billing is exact. And include a "Last updated" timestamp in the modal footer.
sam: UI behavior suggestion: show abbreviated numbers in the compact tooltip (0.003) and expose full text on hover/focus. Also include aria-labels that expand the abbreviated values for screen readers.
maria: Nice. Can design implement the new tooltip variants and add the modal content? I'll do a quick copy QA pass once mocks are posted.
kevin: I'll update the component and drop a screenshot in #design later today. :+1:
